hooks.text: 惩罚性战斗要求及时反应并权衡每次选择，武器不足时还能用数十种物品诅咒或迷惑敌人。
hooks.excerpt: Heresy Supreme revolves around a combat system that is punishing yet rewarding Every choice must be weighed; react in time or face a violent end. And when weapons are not enough, turn to dozens of items to curse, confuse, and drive your enemies into despair.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 手工情境与任务由半程序系统不断重排，敌人、掉落和属性也会随机变化。
hooks.excerpt: Built from a large pool of handcrafted situations and quests, constantly rearranged by a semi-procedural system. Enemies, drops, and stats are randomized. Expect no patterns. Expect no mercy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 艺术朋克图形、注定毁灭的黑暗世界与沉重末日金属共同塑造末世气质。
hooks.excerpt: Mesmerizing art-punk graphic style A wretched world doomed by an unavoidable apocalypse A brutal, haunting doom metal soundtrack
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
